title: CA-479 STILL OPEN: CA-471 gate's pass-directory glob silently keeps the last of several pass-N_* matches, so the completeness gate fires spuriously or passes vacuously with no diagnostic

Commit-time lint selects initiatives from the git index but lints working-tree content, so a violation staged and then fixed unstaged commits clean (TOCTOU between --cached and find)

The A && B || C physical-path relativization at :58 traced correct in all three cases (assignment takes the substitution's status; empty repo_root caught by the -n guard at :61)
code=$? on the line after out=$(...) is not a CA-036 instance here: this file runs set -uo pipefail with no -e (:25)
The absolute EDM_SRD_ROOT handed to both children at :130-131 is CA-320's deliberate one-value-computed-once fix, not an absolute-root regression

The two threshold branches at :106 and :110 can both yield qc-shard-pass-01.md but are mutually exclusive arms of one if, so they cannot collide within a single pass; the cross-wave axis is the live one
G48's advance-on-every-successful-poll half of CA-208 remains correct; only the value advanced to is wrong, recorded so the finding-7 fix is not mistaken for a G48 revert
The CA-471 gate's jq empty check on a multi-line JSONL file is correct: jq's default concatenated-value input mode accepts valid JSONL and fails a truncated final line, the intended direction
CA-252's four-arm split trap (EXIT cleanup-only, INT/TERM/HUP exiting 130/143/129) re-verified intact at :276-279 with no drift
Lock give-up budget asymmetry between the mkdir and flock branches re-derived again and re-confirmed as standing under CA-294/CA-375's explicit do-not-re-file disposition
